Landed: Gerrit change 3421, merged as 07f023db8031f1a09b5d0e51ea1ca3ff35cd63c2 (patch set 2 = local commit 8cc90245e08, LLM-Review +1 by rebar-review-bot, Verified +1 by rebar-ci-bot). `make verify` on that exact tree exited 0: lint + typecheck + import-convention guard passed, default tier 21390 passed / 30 skipped, integration tier 226 passed / 2 skipped (log: worktree .rebar/scratch/3d705fec-verify/make-verify-3.log, run 2026-11-17 PST).

The landing commit carries all three sibling bugs (shared with dissocial-unpleasant-adouri and knightly-salty-orangutan), so file_impact now also lists the sibling files, each marked "shared landing commit only".

AC evidence in `tests/unit/test_eval_scorers.py`: `test_the_criterion_id_specs_using_emits_valid_findings_are_the_expected_set`, `test_a_fired_criterion_arm_finding_is_a_valid_plan_review_finding` (7 params), `test_emits_valid_findings_registers_its_contract_in_a_fresh_interpreter`, `test_emits_valid_findings_rejects_malformed_plan_review_output` (5 params), `test_attributes_g3_vs_g4_credits_a_container_arm_finding`, `test_attributes_g3_vs_g4_matches_the_criteria_list_exactly` (5 params); 13 of them fail against origin/main 05c6414358f. `tests/unit/test_eval.py` run_eval fixtures migrated to the Pass-1 shape and passing.
